q: They visited the home ____ time with the elderly.
explain: to spend time 作目的状语，说明前往的目的。

q: She brought some flowers ____ the room more beautiful.
explain: 不定式 to make 表示目的：为了让房间更漂亮。

q: The students sang songs ____ the old people happy.
explain: to make sb happy 作目的状语。

q: We get up early ____ the first bus.
explain: to catch the bus 表示早起的目的。

q: He saved money ____ a gift for his grandmother.
explain: to buy a gift 作目的状语。

q: They went there ____ the old people's life better.
explain: 动词不定式表目的：为了使老人生活更好。

q: I called you ____ you about the visit.
explain: to tell you 表示打电话的目的。

q: In order ____ on time, we left home early.
explain: in order to do 是“为了……”的固定结构。

q: They cleaned the rooms ____ the elderly a comfortable place.
explain: to give… 作目的状语，表示打扫的目的。

q: It was raining, ____ we stayed at home.
explain: so 表示结果：因为下雨，所以待在家。

q: He couldn't speak, ____ he wrote his feelings down.
explain: so 连接因果，表示“于是”。

q: I like the book ____ it is very interesting.
explain: because 引导原因状语从句。

q: She wanted to help, ____ she didn't know how.
explain: but 表示转折：想帮忙，但不知怎么帮。

q: Words are not enough, ____ actions can show love.
explain: but 表示转折对比。

q: He was tired, ____ he finished the work first.
explain: but 表转折：虽然累，但还是先完成工作。

q: We missed the bus ____ we got up late.
explain: because 引导原因从句，说明错过公交的原因。

q: ____ he was ill, he didn't go to school.
explain: Because 引导原因从句置于句首。

q: The sign uses pictures ____ everyone can understand it.
explain: so that 引导目的状语从句：以便……。

q: Sometimes a smile says more ____ words.
explain: more than 表示“比……更多”，此处比较。

q: My grandma ____ make beautiful paper-cuts when she was young.
explain: used to do 表示过去经常做某事，现在不做了。

q: I ____ getting up early now.
explain: be used to doing 表示“习惯于做某事”。

q: There ____ be a small shop here, but it's gone now.
explain: used to be 表示过去存在、现在不存在。

q: She ____ live in the countryside, but now she lives in the city.
explain: used to live 表示过去的习惯或状态。

q: After years of practice, he ____ the cold weather.
explain: be used to + 名词，表示习惯于。

q: Did your grandma ____ tell you old stories?
explain: 疑问句中助动词 did 后用动词原形 use to。

q: Paper-cutting ____ be a common skill in the past.
explain: used to be 表示过去的普遍状态。

q: I'm not ____ such hot weather yet.
explain: be used to 的否定：not used to + 名词/动名词。

q: He ____ working late, so he doesn't feel tired.
explain: be used to doing：已经习惯了熬夜工作。

q: They ____ play together every day, but now they are busy.
explain: used to play 表示过去经常做、现已不做。

q: If you press this button, the robot ____ working.
explain: 第一条件句：if + 一般现在时，主句用 will + 动词原形。

q: The robot will help you if you ____ it to.
explain: if 从句用一般现在时表将来。

q: If it ____ tomorrow, we will stay at home.
explain: 条件句从句中用一般现在时 rains。

q: You will be tired if you ____ enough sleep.
explain: if 从句用一般现在时的否定 don't get。

q: If the robot ____ down, what will you do?
explain: 条件从句用一般现在时 breaks。

q: We ____ late if we don't hurry.
explain: 主句用 will be 表将来结果。

q: If you ____ hard, you will pass the exam.
explain: if + 一般现在时 study。

q: The machine won't work if you ____ the wrong button.
explain: if 从句用一般现在时 press。

q: If everyone helps, the work ____ easier.
explain: 主句用 will become 表将来。

q: What will happen if the battery ____ out?
explain: 条件从句用一般现在时 runs out。

q: I ____ in Shanghai since 2019.
explain: since 引导时间点，主句用现在完成时 have lived。

q: We ____ here for three years.
explain: for + 时间段，常与现在完成时连用。

q: Sanjiangyuan ____ a protected area since 2000.
explain: since + 时间点用现在完成时 has been。

q: They ____ each other for ten years.
explain: for ten years 与现在完成时 have known 连用。

q: How long ____ you ____ in this school?
explain: How long 提问持续时间，用现在完成时。

q: The animals ____ there since the area was protected.
explain: since 从句配合主句现在完成时。

q: I haven't seen him ____ last month.
explain: since + 过去时间点 last month。

q: She has worked here ____ five years.
explain: for + 时间段 five years。

q: We ____ never ____ such a beautiful place before.
explain: 现在完成时 have visited，never 表示“从未”。

q: The river ____ cleaner since people started to protect it.
explain: since 从句配合主句现在完成时 has become。

q: The little gardener planted the flowers ____.
explain: himself 反身代词，表示“他自己”亲自做。

q: Be careful! Don't hurt ____.
explain: yourself 反身代词，作动词宾语。

q: The children enjoyed ____ in the garden.
explain: enjoy oneself 表示“玩得开心”。

q: I made this cake by ____.
explain: by oneself 表示“独自、亲自”。

q: She taught ____ to grow vegetables.
explain: teach oneself 表示“自学”。

q: We should look after ____ during the trip.
explain: ourselves 反身代词，主语为 we。

q: The robot can clean the room by ____.
explain: by itself 表示“自动、独自”。

q: Help ____ to some fruit, children.
explain: 主语 children 为复数，用 yourselves。

q: He fixed the bike ____ without any help.
explain: himself 作同位语，强调“他亲自”。

q: The flowers don't water ____; we must water them.
explain: themselves 反身代词，主语为 flowers（复数）。

q: Look at the dark clouds. It ____ rain soon.
explain: may 表示可能性：可能要下雨了。

q: He ____ be at home; the lights are on.
explain: must 表示有把握的推测：一定在家。

q: She ____ be tired; she has just had a good rest.
explain: can't 表示否定推测：不可能累。

q: They ____ arrive late because of the heavy traffic.
explain: might 表示较小的可能性。

q: The story ____ be true; nobody believes it.
explain: can't 表示“不可能”的否定推测。

q: We ____ reach the moon one day in the future.
explain: could 表示将来的可能性。

q: Whose book is this? It ____ be Tom's; his name is on it.
explain: must 表示有把握的肯定推测。

q: He ____ know the answer, but I'm not sure.
explain: may 表示不确定的可能性。

q: This ____ be the right way; I'm not certain.
explain: might 表示较弱、不确定的可能。

q: She didn't answer the phone. She ____ be sleeping.
explain: could 表示一种可能：可能在睡觉。

q: We ____ save water to protect the environment.
explain: should 表示“应该”，给出建议。

q: You ____ waste paper; trees are precious.
explain: shouldn't 表示“不应该”。

q: You ____ turn off the lights when you leave.
explain: had better do 表示“最好做某事”。

q: We ____ to recycle bottles and cans.
explain: ought to do 表示“应该”。

q: You'd better ____ a coat; it's cold outside.
explain: had better 后接动词原形 wear。

q: Students ____ plant more trees on Tree Planting Day.
explain: should 给出积极建议。

q: We ____ to keep our school clean and green.
explain: ought to 表示义务、应该。

q: You ____ throw rubbish on the ground.
explain: shouldn't 表示“不应该”。

q: It's raining. We'd better ____ now.
explain: had better 的否定：had better not + 动词原形。

q: To have a green month, everyone ____ do their part.
explain: ought to 表示“理应”，强调每个人的责任。

q: Confucius is the philosopher ___ believed in lifelong learning.
explain: 先行词 philosopher 指人，定语从句作主语用 who。

q: The Analects, ___ was written by his disciples, is still read today.
explain: 先行词 The Analects 指物，用 which 引导定语从句。

q: This is the old temple ___ honours Confucius.
explain: 指物的定语从句，口语中常用 that。

q: Which sentence is correct?
options: Confucius is a teacher he lived 2,500 years ago.
Confucius is a teacher who lived 2,500 years ago.
Confucius is a teacher which lived 2,500 years ago.
explain: 指人用 who，且不能重复主语 he（避免双主语）。

q: The teacher ___ wrote this book is from Shanghai.
explain: 先行词 teacher 指人作主语，用 who。

q: I have a cat ___ can open the door by itself.
explain: 指动物用 which（也可用 that）。

q: She is the teacher ___ teaches us English. （口语中最常用）
explain: 口语中 that 可代替 who/which，尤其信息不可省时。

q: 定语从句通常紧跟在什么之后？
explain: 定语从句告诉我们说的是哪个人或物，通常紧跟在名词之后。

q: 指物或动物时，下列哪个关系词不能用？
explain: who 只指人；指物/动物用 which 或 that。

q: The book ___ I borrowed yesterday is very interesting.
explain: 先行词 book 指物，作宾语用 that（或 which）。

q: Edison is the inventor ___ lab burnt down in 1914.
explain: 表所属关系（发明家的实验室）用 whose。

q: The laboratory ___ Curie worked was very cold in winter.
explain: 先行词是地点 laboratory，从句中作地点状语用 where。

q: 1879 was the year ___ Edison produced a working light bulb.
explain: 先行词是时间 year，用 when 引导。

q: I met a girl ___ father is a scientist.
explain: 表“女孩的父亲”所属关系，用 whose。

q: Paris is the city ___ many great minds once lived.
explain: 先行词是地点 city，从句中表“在该城市”，用 where。

q: I still remember the day ___ the results were announced.
explain: 先行词是时间 day，用 when。

q: "The house where Newton was born" 等于 "The house ___ Newton was born in"。
explain: where = in/at which，故可改为 which + 介词 in。

q: whose 用来表示什么？
explain: whose 表示所属关系，可指人、动物甚至物。

q: This is the village ___ I spent my childhood.
explain: 先行词是地点 village，从句中作地点状语用 where。

q: Summer is the season ___ many people go travelling.
explain: 先行词是时间 season，用 when。

q: The river is ___ dirty ___ swim in.
explain: too + 形容词 + to + 动词，表“太脏以至于不能游泳”。

q: He spoke ___ fast ___ I could not understand him.
explain: so + 副词 + that + 从句结构。

q: "The air is too bad to breathe." 改写为 so...that 结构正确的是：
options: The air is so bad that we cannot breathe.
The air is so bad that we can breathe.
The air is so badly that we cannot breathe.
explain: too...to 含否定义，改 so...that 时从句要加 cannot。

q: There is ___ rubbish on the beach that we cannot walk freely.
explain: rubbish 不可数，用 so much...that。

q: "She is so young that she can't join the club." 改为 too...to 结构：
options: She is too young to join the club.
She is too young not to join the club.
She is so young to join the club.
explain: so young that can't = too young to；to 后不能再加 not。

q: 关于 too...to...，下列说法正确的是：
options: 它本身含否定义，to 后不加 not
explain: too...to 已含“不能”之意，不可在 to 后再加 not。

q: ___ few birds come here now that the forest feels empty.
explain: so few + 名词 + that 结构，表“鸟太少以至于……”。

q: The box is too heavy ___.
explain: too...to + 动词原形；宾语 it 不再重复（box 已是逻辑宾语）。

q: He was ___ tired ___ he fell asleep at once.
explain: so + 形容词 + that + 从句。

q: The water is too cold ___ in.
explain: too + adj. + to + 动词原形。

q: 强调句的基本结构是：
options: It is/was + 强调部分 + that/who + 其余
There is + 强调部分 + that
It has + 强调部分 + which
explain: 强调句型为 It is/was + 强调部分 + that/who + 句子其余部分。

q: 强调 "Tom broke the window" 的主语，正确的是：
options: It was Tom who broke the window.
It was Tom which broke the window.
It was Tom whom broke the window.
explain: 强调主语且指人，用 who（或 that）。

q: It is plastic ___ pollutes the sea.
explain: 强调部分 plastic 指物，用 that。

q: 强调时间状语 "last Monday" 应该用：
explain: 强调句中无论强调时间或地点，一律用 that，不用 when/where。

q: It was in Shanghai ___ I first met her.
explain: 强调地点状语 in Shanghai，强调句中一律用 that。

q: 强调宾语 "We need clean water most" 的正确改写：
options: It is clean water that we need most.
It is clean water who we need most.
There is clean water that we need most.
explain: 强调宾语 clean water（指物）用 that。

q: 强调句改成否定，正确的是：
options: It was not Tom who broke the window; it was Jim.
It was no Tom who broke the window.
It wasn't Tom broke the window.
explain: 否定强调句：It was not + 强调部分 + who/that...。

q: 关于强调句中其余部分的时态，正确的说法是：
explain: 强调句其余部分保留原时态，不要把第二个动词改成 is。

q: 对主语提问的强调句疑问形式：
options: Who was it that broke the window?
Who it was broke the window?
Who that broke the window was it?
explain: 疑问强调句：Who was it that...？

q: It was last Friday ___ we started the campaign.
explain: 强调时间 last Friday，用 that。

q: 主动句 "They sell tickets online" 的被动语态是：
explain: 一般现在时被动：am/is/are + 过去分词，sell 的过去分词 sold。

q: "Jia Ling directed the film." 的被动语态是：
options: The film was directed by Jia Ling.
The film is directed by Jia Ling.
The film directed by Jia Ling.
explain: 一般过去时被动：was/were + 过去分词；direct 过去分词 directed。

q: 被动语态中 by + 动作执行者通常在什么时候使用？
options: 当执行者重要或令人意外时
explain: 只有在执行者重要或令人意外时才加 by；显而易见或不明时可省。

q: write 的过去分词是：
explain: write 为不规则动词，过去分词是 written。

q: The building ___ in 1925.
explain: 过去某年用一般过去时被动 was built。

q: "Was the film directed by Jia Ling?" 的正确简短回答：
explain: 被动语态疑问由 be 动词构成，回答用 was。

q: The story ___ in a hurry.（否定）
explain: 被动否定：was not + 过去分词 written。

q: break 的过去分词是：
explain: break 不规则，过去分词为 broken。

q: "Thousands of fans loved the hero." 的被动语态是：
options: The hero was loved by thousands of fans.
The hero is loved thousands of fans.
The hero loved by thousands of fans.
explain: 过去时被动 was loved，执行者重要故保留 by。

q: 被动语态强调的是：
explain: 被动语态聚焦承受动作的对象，而非执行者。

q: 现在完成时被动语态的结构是：
explain: 现在完成时被动：have/has + been + 过去分词。

q: "They have sold all the tickets." 的被动语态是：
options: All the tickets have been sold.
explain: 现在完成被动 have been sold。

q: The hall ___ just ___.
explain: 现在完成被动：has been cleaned，just 放中间。

q: ___ the seats ___ yet?
explain: 现在完成被动疑问：Have the seats been booked yet?

q: The song ___ since 2010.
explain: since 2010 表延续到现在，用现在完成被动 has been sung。

q: 区分："The concert was held last Friday" 与 "The concert has been held three times this year"，后者用现在完成是因为：
explain: this year 表与现在相关的时间段，故用现在完成时。

q: The microphone ___ yet.（否定，现在完成被动）
explain: yet 多与现在完成连用，否定为 has not been fixed。

q: A new album ___ by her.
explain: 现在完成被动 has been recorded。

q: 下列哪个时间词常与现在完成时连用？
explain: already/just/yet/ever/never/since/for 常与现在完成连用。

q: "Has your song been played on the radio?" 是什么时态语态？
explain: have/has + been + 过去分词为现在完成时被动。

q: 转述陈述句 "I am tired," she said. 正确的是：
options: She said that she was tired.
She said that she is tired.
She said that I was tired.
explain: 引述动词为过去时，从句时态后退 am→was，人称 I→she。

q: 转述一般疑问句要用哪个连接词？
explain: 转述一般疑问句用 if 或 whether，并改为陈述句语序。

q: "Are you ready?" he asked. 的间接引语是：
options: He asked if I was ready.
He asked if was I ready.
He asked that I was ready.
explain: 用 if + 陈述句语序，was 后退时态。

q: "Where do you live?" she asked me. 转述为：
options: She asked me where I lived.
She asked me where did I live.
She asked me where do I live.
explain: 特殊疑问句保留疑问词，改陈述语序，do you live→I lived。

q: 转述时 will 变成：
explain: 间接引语中 will→would。

q: "I saw it yesterday." 转述为：
options: He said he had seen it the day before.
He said he saw it yesterday.
He said he has seen it yesterday.
explain: saw→had seen，yesterday→the day before。

q: 间接引语中 now 通常变为：
explain: now→then，today→that day，here→there。

q: 转述时 can 变成：
explain: 间接引语中 can→could。

q: "Will you help me now?" 转述为：
options: She asked if I would help her then.
She asked if I will help her now.
She asked that I would help her then.
explain: will→would，me→her，now→then，用 if 引导。

q: 转述疑问句时，语序应改为：
explain: 间接疑问句一律用陈述句语序。

q: 对过去行为做猜测/判断的结构是：
options: 情态动词 + have + 过去分词
情态动词 + 动词原形
explain: modal + have + 过去分词用于推测过去。

q: The ground is wet. It ___ last night.
explain: 对过去很肯定的推测用 must have done。

q: She isn't answering. She ___ out.
explain: 对过去的可能推测用 may have gone。

q: "should have done" 通常表达：
options: 本该做却没做（后悔/责备）
explain: should have done 表本应发生却未发生，含后悔或责备。

q: He ___ the money; he was with me all day.
explain: 非常肯定没发生用 can't / couldn't have done。

q: I ___ harder for the test.（含后悔）
explain: 表后悔“本该更努力”用 should have studied。

q: They ___ yet; the flight left only an hour ago.
explain: 很肯定还没到用 couldn't have arrived。

q: He looks happy. He ___ the test.
explain: 由结果很肯定推测过去用 must have passed。

q: "could have done" 还可以表示：
explain: could have done 可表“本来可能/本可以（但没做）”。

q: 这些结构中的“have + 过去分词”部分会随时态变化吗？
explain: 猜测体现在情态动词上，have + 过去分词保持不变。

q: Humans ___ on Mars one day, scientists believe.
explain: 对未来的简单预测用一般将来时 will + 动词原形。

q: At 7 p.m. tomorrow, I ___ over the North Pole.
explain: 将来某一时刻正在进行的动作用将来进行时 will be + V-ing。

q: Look at those black clouds — it ___ rain.
explain: 有明显迹象的预测用 be going to。

q: "The bag is heavy." "OK, I ___ help you."
explain: 说话当下临时做出的决定用 will。

q: This time tomorrow, the astronauts ___ experiments in the greenhouse.
explain: This time tomorrow 表将来某刻正进行，用将来进行时。

q: ___ you ___ the laptop tonight? I'd like to borrow it.
explain: 用将来进行时礼貌询问对方的计划。

q: I've already decided: I ___ watch the Mars landing live tonight.
explain: 早已计划好的打算用 be going to。

q: By 2100, people ___ in space cities, some scientists predict.
explain: 对遥远未来的预测用一般将来时 will。

q: Don't call her at three — she ___ the test then.
explain: 将来某时正在进行的动作用将来进行时。

q: I promise I ___ you tonight after the show.
explain: 承诺用 will。

q: By 1904, Helen Keller ___ from university.
explain: "到1904年"之前已完成的动作用过去完成时 had + 过去分词。

q: When I reached the station, the train ___ already ___.
explain: 过去时间点之前已发生用过去完成时 had + 过去分词。

q: She ___ ten new words before her teacher arrived.
explain: 在另一个过去动作(arrived)之前完成，用过去完成时。

q: After she ___ her homework, she went out to play.
explain: after 引导的较早动作用过去完成时。

q: He ___ never ___ of her before he read the book.
explain: before 之前的经历，用过去完成时 had + 过去分词。

q: By the age of 10, he ___ to five countries.
explain: "到10岁时"之前累计完成，用过去完成时。

q: Choose the sentence that correctly shows the earlier action with the past perfect.
options: She had waited for an hour before her teacher came.
She waited for an hour before her teacher had come.
She has waited before her teacher came.
explain: 较早动作(waited)用过去完成，较晚动作(came)用一般过去。

q: ___ you ever ___ of Helen Keller before reading her letter?
explain: 以过去某点(reading)为参照的之前经历，用过去完成时疑问 Had ... heard。

q: The room was empty; everyone ___ home.
explain: 在过去(was empty)之前已发生，用过去完成时。

q: When we got to the cinema, the film ___.
explain: 到达之前电影已开演，用过去完成时。

q: Mount Everest is ___ mountain in the world.
explain: 单音节形容词 tall 最高级为 the tallest。

q: The Taj Mahal is ___ at sunset than at noon.
explain: 多音节形容词 beautiful 比较级为 more beautiful。

q: Asia is ___ continent on Earth.
explain: large 最高级为 the largest。

q: Shanghai is one of ___ cities in the world.
explain: busy 以辅音+y结尾，最高级为 the busiest。

q: Laos is ___ Vietnam.
explain: "不如……"用 not as + 形容词原级 + as。

q: This is ___ film I have ever seen.
explain: interesting 最高级为 the most interesting。

q: Which sentence is correct?
options: The Gobi is bigger than the Taklamakan.
The Gobi is more bigger than the Taklamakan.
The Gobi is biggest than the Taklamakan.
explain: 一次只用一个比较标志，big 比较级为 bigger，不能说 more bigger。

q: My English is ___ than before, but still not good enough.
explain: good 的比较级是不规则形式 better。

q: China is almost ___ the whole of Europe.
explain: "和……一样大"用 as + 原级 + as。

q: Of all the students, Tom runs ___.
explain: fast 最高级为 the fastest。

q: If we recycle more, we ___ trees.
explain: 第一型条件句：if + 一般现在, will + 动词原形。

q: If it ___ tomorrow, the picnic will be cancelled.
explain: 第一型条件句的 if 从句用一般现在时。

q: If I ___ a scientist, I would study climate change.
explain: 第二型(与现在相反)：if + 过去时(be 用 were), would + 动词。

q: If everyone walked to school, the air ___ cleaner.
explain: 第二型条件句主句用 would + 动词原形。

q: If I ___ you, I would go home now.
explain: 第二型条件句中 be 动词各人称都用 were。

q: ___ we save water, we will be in trouble.
explain: Unless = If ... not，"除非我们节水，否则会有麻烦"。

q: If the oceans ___ by ten metres, many cities would disappear.
explain: 想象的未来(第二型)，if 从句用一般过去时 rose。

q: ___ you help us if we asked?
explain: 第二型条件句的疑问主句用 would。

q: What ___ if nobody acts?
explain: 对真实可能的将来发问，用第一型 will happen。

q: When the sun ___, the temperature will fall.
explain: when 引导真实且确定的时间状语从句，用一般现在时表将来。

q: I ___ in Shanghai since 2010.
explain: since + 时间点，用现在完成时 have + 过去分词。

q: We ___ friends for ten years.
explain: for + 时间段，用现在完成时。

q: ___ you ever ___ a lion dance?
explain: ever 与现在完成时连用：Have you ever seen...?

q: I have ___ tried mooncakes before.
explain: "从没"用 never 与现在完成时连用。

q: He has ___ to Beijing — he is still there now.
explain: has gone to 表示"去了还没回"。

q: He has ___ to Beijing twice; he loves the city.
explain: has been to 表示"去过(已回来)"的经历。

q: Have you finished your homework ___?
explain: yet 用于疑问句末，表示"还(没)"。

q: Which uses the simple past correctly with a definite past time?
options: I saw the film last night.
I have seen the film last night.
I see the film last night.
explain: 有明确过去时间(last night)用一般过去时，不用现在完成时。

q: She has ___ arrived, so she is still putting down her bags.
explain: just 与现在完成时连用，表"刚刚"。

q: We ___ each other since primary school.
explain: since + 时间点，用现在完成时 have known。

q: We stayed inside ___ it was raining.
explain: because 引导原因状语从句。

q: The gift sounded bad in Chinese, ___ we chose another one.
explain: so 表结果，"所以"。

q: I like Chinese food. ___, I can't eat spicy food.
explain: However 表转折，较正式，位于句首后接逗号。

q: ___ he is new here, he has already learned many customs.
explain: Although 引导让步状语从句，"尽管"。

q: He was late; ___, the meeting was delayed.
explain: therefore 表结果，较正式，常用于分号后。

q: Which sentence is correct?
options: Because it rained, we stayed home.
Because it rained, so we stayed home.
So it rained, because we stayed home.
explain: because 和 so 不能在同一句中同时使用。

q: ___ it was her first time in China, she felt at home.
explain: Even though 表让步，"即使/尽管"。

q: Chinese tea is famous, ___ not every Chinese person drinks it every day.
explain: yet 表转折，相当于 but。

q: ___ you are tired, please rest for a while.
explain: Since 在此表原因，"既然"。

q: We gave candy ___ it is sweet and lucky.
explain: because 引导原因。

q: "I wandered lonely as a cloud" uses which device?
explain: 含 as 把人比作云，是明喻(simile)。

q: "Time is a river." This sentence is a ___.
explain: 直接说 X 是 Y，不用 like/as，是暗喻(metaphor)。

q: "The wind whispered in the trees." This is an example of ___.
explain: 把人的动作(whisper)赋予风，是拟人(personification)。

q: "I have a dream. I have a dream. I have a dream today." This uses ___.
explain: 同一句反复出现以增强节奏与情感，是重复(repetition)。

q: "Silver streams, sleepy stars, silent night" is an example of ___.
explain: 邻近词开头相同辅音 /s/，是头韵(alliteration)。

q: Which one is a simile?
explain: 含 like 的比较是明喻。

q: Which one is a metaphor?
explain: 直接说"书是门"、不用 like/as，是暗喻。

q: "The boy runs as fast as a deer." The device is ___.
explain: as...as 结构作比较，是明喻。

q: "'Hope' is the thing with feathers" treats hope as a bird without 'like'. This is ___.
explain: 不用 like/as 直接把希望当作鸟，是暗喻。

q: Why do poets use figurative language?
options: To make readers see and feel more
explain: 修辞把想法变成画面，让读者"看见"与"感受"更多。

q: Direct: "I love you." Reported: He said he ___ her.
explain: 引述动词为过去时，现在时 love 变为过去时 loved。

q: Direct: "I am writing a play." Reported: She said she ___ a play.
explain: 现在进行时 am writing 在间接引语中变为 was writing。

q: Direct: "I have seen him." Reported: She said she ___ him.
explain: 现在完成时 have seen 变为过去完成时 had seen。

q: Direct: "I will visit Verona." Reported: Juliet said she ___ Verona.
explain: will 在间接引语中变为 would。

q: Direct: "Go home!" Reported: He told her ___ home.
explain: 祈使句(命令)转述用 tell sb. to + 动词原形。

q: Direct: "Don't be late." Reported: She asked him ___ late.
explain: 否定祈使句转述用 ask sb. not to + 动词原形。

q: Direct: "Did you read it?" Reported: She asked me ___ it.
explain: 一般疑问句转述用 if，时态后移为过去完成时。

q: Direct: "Where does he live?" Reported: She asked where he ___.
explain: 特殊疑问句转述保留疑问词、改陈述语序、时态后移为 lived。

q: He ___ that he would come back soon.
explain: promise(承诺)后接 that 从句，符合语境。

q: The teacher said that the Earth ___ round.
explain: 客观真理在间接引语中时态可保留现在时。
